thread:
Mia Gomez: Quick check-in after the microsite launch + webinar teaser. Early signal: signup volume healthy but downstream activation stalled at first prompt. Need to pick a fast experiment set.

Liam O'Connor: Saw the live traffic. PPC CTR ~7.1%. Organic post performed better on dev channels. Problem: onboarding drop at the sample prompt step.

Zoe Kim: My idea: replace "RSVP to webinar" with "Claim 75 trial credits" in the hero and push a short demo video in the registration flow. Lower friction -> higher activation?

Ravi Patel: Can we segment routing? If company_domain matches known enterprise list send to sales; otherwise stay self-serve. Also add a lightweight scoring event for webinar registrants (engagement_score).

GrowthBot: Mini-experiment summary (12h):
```
Arm A (RSVP): 6,412 impressions -> 468 clicks (7.3%) -> 101 signups -> 17 activations
Arm B (75 credits + demo): 6,598 impressions -> 499 clicks (7.6%) -> 156 signups -> 54 activations
Activation rate lift ArmB vs ArmA: +16.5pp (p=0.012)
Video view correlation: users who watched >30s -> activation rate 62%
```

Mia Gomez: Strong signal for credits + demo. Two follow-ups: 1) content ops to swap hero copy & thumbnail 2) product to add demo autoplay (muted) in signup modal as A/B.

Liam O'Connor: For routing: I'll add a rule based on domain suffix and company_size param. Also suggest we create a lightweight webhook to SalesOps with webinar_registrant payload.

Zoe Kim: On messaging: benchmark blurb should highlight "time-to-first-working-integration" and "templates for common API flows". We should include a mini case: "10-minute prompt-template for PR drafts" to make it concrete.

Ravi Patel: Suggest delaying broad prompt-template swap. Instead roll out a templates carousel in the post-signup modal for 10% of users. Track events: template_carousel_shown, template_selected.

Mia Gomez: Action list:
- Zoe: new hero copy + demo thumbnail (today)
- Liam: routing + SalesOps webhook (this sprint)
- Ravi: templates carousel canary 10% + events (this week)
- Analytics: add onboarding.watch_demo_30s and engagement_score metric to dashboard

Liam O'Connor: Will set a short alert if activation rate drops below 10% post-change.

Mia Gomez: Great. We'll reconvene Thu morning with updated numbers. :sparkles:
